real_defects.issue: --max-churn, --what-if and --months read an empty value as 0 (Number("") === 0), so `--max-churn "$LIMIT"` with LIMIT unset set a 0% limit and failed every cron run. Now rejected as not a number; failing-first test.

The 'run main when this is the entry script' check compared import.meta.url with a hand-built file:// string (`file://${process.argv[1]}`, 250 guards; new URL(`file://...`) and new URL(argv[1], 'file://'), 61 more; 311 guards in 310 files). import.meta.url is percent-encoded, so from a folder with a space (the template form), '#' or '%' in its name, or any Windows path, the CLI printed nothing and exited 0: `--help` was silent and a CI gate such as --max-churn or a security check's exit 1 always passed. Reproduced with social-preview-check copied under 'My Projects' and stripe-churn under 'a#b'. Fixed in all 310 by a codemod to pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href (lazy await import('node:url') in the 3 browser-loaded modules); new lint platform/ci/check_cli_entry.py fails on the fragile forms.
